description.blurb: S/2004 S 50 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2004 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2004 S 50 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 22.3 million km in 1260.44 days. It has an inclination of 164.0° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.450.
